description: PC's mails changing the deliveries of the fictional M01 order (VLX, four lines: VX-W24-BK/HW-1001 12200 m, VX-W24-RD/HW-1002 6100 m, VX-C2F05/CB-2001 6000 m, VX-C4B22/CB-2007 3000 m) after its confirmation, as Sales would paste them into 'Thay đổi nội bộ' (ticket 10). `answer`: the model's reading, [line words, [[quantity words or null, date words], ...]]. `want`: what code keeps, [line or null, problem or null, [[quantity, ISO date], ...]], the lines in the order's order then the refused ones; a value the paste does not settle is null. A numeric date the paste's own dates do not settle (03/12 with no day over 12 beside it) is left to Sales; a line the order does not have is refused, never matched.
